svg.text: Schematic view. Pins are grouped by function, not by where they sit on each board: wire by the label printed beside each hole.
+ lead to 5 V; stripe side to GND
Every point marked +5V joins the ESP32's 5V pin (USB power passed straight through). Every point marked GND joins the ESP32's GND pin.
Motors take power from 5V, never from 3V3. The sensor takes 3.3 V only. R1 to R4 are optional. Never feed the 5V pin from a second supply while USB is plugged in.
Pins on each module are printed GND, VCC, IN.
Motor 1 on/off and strength (back of wrist)
VCC of M1, M2, M3 and M4
Motor power: four wires from one shared 5 V strip
GND of M1, M2, M3 and M4
Motor ground: four wires from one shared GND strip
C1 + lead on the 5 V strip
C1 stripe lead on the GND strip
Absorbs the dip when motors start
Optional, R1 to R4: each motor's IN wire
Stops a brief buzz at power-up; the circuit works without them
Setup button (the board's internal pull-up is used)
